content.question: What is the practical purpose of a named object shape?

options.text: To describe which properties and value types another piece of code expects.
To force every object to have exactly the same extra properties.

feedback.correct: A named shape communicates a data contract that can be reused and checked.
feedback.incorrect: A named shape communicates a data contract that can be reused and checked.

content.title: Forge takeaway & Lesson completion
takeaways: **Mental model:** A type can be a reusable map of the information another piece of code expects.
**Senior habit:** When a function accepts a complicated object, name the shape instead of letting every call site rediscover the contract.
nextSteps: Create a `Book` type with `title` as a string, `pages` as a number, and `available` as a boolean. Then create one valid `Book` value.
